name: Customized Cone Tracing
definition: A cone tracing algorithm modified for aesthetic results, specifically altering occlusion, specular, and diffuse cone behaviors compared to the standard model.
summary: Customized Cone Tracing modifies standard Voxel Cone Tracing by replacing generic models with specialized, experimentally tuned functions for occlusion, specular, and diffuse cones to improve aesthetic quality and mitigate artifacts.
